profile.headline: Teaching machines to see and navigate in 3D (he/him)
profile.summary:
Over a decade of experience leading and executing complex multi-year software projects. Broad range of programming languages and tools.

Led the avionics and GNC of a 30-lbs drone, and designed the avionics and power system of a cubesat that was launched from the ISS. Helped write an embedded OS that runs on millions of consumer devices. Now teaching machines to see and navigate in 3D.

Educational background in software and computer engineering, astronautics, and physics. I like to work at the crossroads of software, physics, and geometry.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing and writing software for:
- Visual-inertial SLAM using factor graphs (GTSAM and Ceres).
- Dense 3D reconstruction (TSDF, NeRF, Gaussian Splatting).
- Navigation planner, terrain traversability and obstacle detection.
- 2D and 3D registration.
- 3D simulation (Unreal Engine).

Technical lead of several $XXM software projects. Duties:
- Literature review, design, planning, and budgeting.
- Timely and successful execution of the projects.
- Daily coordination of the engineering team executing the projects.
- Communication with external stakeholders.

Engineering manager. I like helping people improve their workflow and become more productive.

Before LLMs took over coding completely, I did a reimplementation of GTSAM's Schur complement function to be more flexible (supporting stereo and monocular measurements together), easier to use well (no need to guess a damping parameter), faster, and mathematically more correct. I'm particularly proud of that. Now that robots do the coding, I enjoy finding ways for them to do more and better with less human supervision.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Project Management · Visual SLAM · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Julia (Programming Language) · CUDA · OpenGL Shading Language (GLSL) · Nonlinear Optimization · Computer Vision

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fuchsia (open-source, capability-based microkernel OS).

"Android Things" (Android for IoT devices): Google Assistant integration. Launched in smart speakers, displays, alarm clocks, and soundbars from Lenovo, LG, Polk, JBL, iHome, and KitchenAid.

gRPC for iOS (open-source RPC library with Objective-C code generation). Used by all iOS Google apps.

Web APIs and microservices infrastructure (OAuth 2, routing, automatic payload transformation, distributed tracing, metrics). Google-internal version of what later was open-sourced as Istio. The project was so successful that it was adopted for internal communications by all microservices at Google. Authored part of Google's remote API design guide.

positions.title: Research Assistant in the Space Systems Lab
positions.description:
MicroMAS 3U cubesat: Designed the avionics and power subsystems.

Talaris: 30-lbs drone, part of MIT's entry into the Google Lunar X-Prize competition. Lead the design and implementation of avionics, GNC, and telemetry.

Developed an expert system for automatic drone design, under the supervision of Prof. Jeff Hoffman.

positions.title: Research Assistant in the Low Temperature Physics Laboratory
positions.description:
Assembled a Scanning Tunneling Microscope (mechanics, electronics, instrumentation and programming) coupled within a Helium Dilution Refrigerator able to reach a temperature of 1.5 mili-Kelvin.

Research assistant of quantum effects in the mili-Kelvin range; mostly magnetic vortices in superconductors.

positions.title: Intern at openlab
positions.description: Scaled the profiling tool used to optimize tasks sent to CERN's Grid (distributed datacenters), so that it wasn't limited by how long ran the process being profiled.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Front-end programming of a Content-Management System for clients in the fashion industry to showcase their catalogs in a stylish and appealing way.

educations.schoolName: Universidad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
